test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Choose the option that best describes the meaning of the idioms and phrases underlined in the given sentence.

A __jack of all trades__ cannot survive in the world of specialisation.

options.text: A person who can do many things but is not an expert in any

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom** "a jack of all trades" **refers to **a person who can do many different types of work but is not necessarily very skilled or an expert in any of them.**
 
• This** idiom** is often used to emphasize the variety of skills a person possesses, but also to highlight their lack of specialization.
 
• The correct meaning provided by Option 2 is **"A person who can do many things but is not an expert in any."**
 
• The other options do not accurately capture the essence of the idiom.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2 (A person who can do many things but is not an expert in any)**.
